passages.note: Authored measure that temporarily hands congressional map-drawing to the legislature via AB 604 while reaffirming the Citizens Redistricting Commission's permanent role from 2031 onward.

rows.reasoning: Rivas authored ACA 8 (2025-2026), which temporarily requires use of the legislature-passed congressional districts under AB 604 in specific response to Texas's mid-decade redistricting, while its own text states it is 'the policy of the State of California to support the use of fair, independent, and nonpartisan redistricting commissions nationwide' and continues the Citizens Redistricting Commission's role beginning in 2031. This mixes a temporary legislature-drawn map with an affirmed permanent preference for an independent commission, so it does not establish any single rung's full text as his standing position on who should draw district boundaries.
